scores.notes: Baseline pair001: Both show towering water walls and a hill town, but the left sky is bright pale daylight/dawn with a sunlit horizon while the right is a dark stormy night sky with moonlight; the day-versus-night lighting conflicts.

Baseline pair002: Left: haloed Jesus standing in the boat; right: haloed figure on the cross. Both have the same shoulder-length dark brown hair, full dark beard, long narrow face and olive skin, in matching blue himation over light chiton.

Baseline pair003: Left Jesus on the water is clear (long dark hair, full dark beard). The right crucified figure is a tiny distant figure with a bowed head; only dark hair and beard are visible and the face cannot be judged.

Baseline pair004: Left crucified Jesus has long dark brown hair, a short full dark beard and slim build; the small right figure standing on the waves shows the same long dark hair, dark beard and slim build in a blue-grey cloak over a light tunic, with nothing conflicting.

Baseline pair005: Both are night scenes on the same sandy shore and seabed beside the sea with glowing light overhead. Left shows the path between water walls and right shows Moses on the adjoining beach with cliffs and a town; the right sea is not visibly parted yet, but nothing about the place conflicts.

Baseline pair006: Left Jesus at the tomb is clear (long dark wavy hair, full dark beard). The right crucified figure is small and distant with a bowed, thorn-crowned head; only dark hair and beard can be seen and the face can't be judged.

Baseline pair007: The distant left figure on the water and the close-up right figure at the tomb share long dark brown wavy hair to the shoulders, a full dark beard, similar apparent age (about 30s) and slim build.

Baseline pair008: The left Moses at the shore and the right Moses with the staff beside Aaron are both elderly with a bald or high balding crown, white hair at the sides, a long full white beard and weathered tan skin. The left's side hair is somewhat longer and wavier, which is not a clear conflict.

Baseline pair009: The left crucified figure is tiny and distant with a bowed head; only dark hair and beard are visible. The right Jesus at the tomb is clear (long dark wavy hair, dark beard), but identity can't be compared from the left.

Baseline pair010: Compared Peter's head in both icons (left leaping from the boat, right haloed and reaching from the boat): both have short curly dark-grey hair, a short salt-and-pepper beard, the same oval face and skin tone. The right is slightly greyer but still reads as one individual.
Baseline pair011: Left Jesus at the tomb and right Jesus on the boat both have long dark brown wavy hair, a full dark beard, a similar long face and olive skin at a similar age.

Baseline pair012: Left Peter leaping by day and right Peter stepping onto the water at night are both middle-aged men with dark greying hair and a salt-and-pepper beard greying at the chin. The left curls are tighter and the right hair looser and wavier, but no clear identity cue conflicts.

Baseline pair013: The left crucified figure is small and distant with a bowed, thorn-crowned head; only dark hair and beard are visible. The right Jesus on the boat is clear (long dark hair, dark beard), but the left face can't be judged.

Baseline pair014: Left Jesus standing in the boat and the smaller right figure on the waves both have long dark brown hair to the shoulders, a full dark beard and a slim build in a dark blue mantle over a light tunic.

Baseline pair015: Both gold-sky icons show the same crossing: a sandy dry path running between parted blue-teal sea walls, with a rocky shore at the near end and light or fire in the sky. The left adds a hill town at one side, which fits a wider viewpoint.

Baseline pair016: Compared Jesus at the tomb (left, arm raised) with the distant haloed figure on the water (right): both have long dark-brown wavy hair, a full dark beard, the same adult age and olive skin, in a blue cloak over a pale tunic.

Baseline pair017: Compared Moses with the staff on the sea floor (left) and the white-bearded haloed man beside young Aaron (right): both are elderly with white hair and a long full white beard, a lean face and a dark cloak. The right Moses's hair is somewhat longer, but there is no conflicting cue.

Baseline pair018: Compared Jesus standing on the waves (left) with Jesus standing in the boat (right): both have long dark-brown hair, a dark full beard, the same age and face shape, and a blue-grey cloak over a pale tunic.

Baseline pair019: Both are night scenes with dark teal storm-wave walls of water, a wet sandy and rocky sea floor, crowds walking, and fiery light (a sky glow on the left, a pillar of fire on the right). The left is seen from the shore with desert cliffs, the right from inside the corridor, which fits a change of viewpoint.

Baseline pair020: Compared the icon Christ at Lazarus's tomb (left) with Christ walking on the water (right): both have brown, centre-parted shoulder-length hair, a short brown beard, a cross-inscribed halo, a pinkish tunic with a red stripe and a blue-black himation.

Baseline pair021: Compared watercolor Jesus at the tomb (left) with Jesus at the bow (right): both have long dark-brown hair, a full dark beard, the same adult age and face shape, and a blue-grey cloak over a pale tunic.

Baseline pair022: Daniel on the left (gazing up at the wheels) is elderly and fair-skinned, with thin grey hair and a grey beard. Daniel in the lions' den (right) is a younger man with clearly darker brown skin, close-cropped dark hair and a short salt-and-pepper beard, so skin tone and age conflict.

Baseline pair023: Compared the small crucified icon figure (left) with Christ at the tomb (right): both have brown shoulder-length hair, a short brown beard, a cross-inscribed halo and a blue himation.

Baseline pair024: Compared Moses beside Aaron (left) with the staff-bearing leader in the centre of the column (right): both are elderly with wavy white hair, a full white beard and a lean, lined face, wearing a dark-brown cloak over a pale tunic.

Baseline pair025: Compared Moses on the shore with his arm outstretched (left) with the staff-bearing leader in the centre of the column (right): both are elderly with swept-back white hair, a full white beard and a lean face, wearing a dark-brown cloak over a pale tunic.

Baseline pair026: Compared Moses with the staff at the left edge of the sea floor (left) with the haloed Moses stretching his arm over the sea (right): both are elderly with white hair, a full white beard and a lean face, in a brown cloak over a pale tunic.

Baseline pair027: Compared Moses raising his staff on the shore (left) with Moses standing at the right of the column (right): both are elderly with white, ear-length-or-longer hair, a full white beard, a tanned lean face, and a dark-brown cloak over a pale tunic.

Baseline pair028: Compared icon Christ walking on the water (left) with the crucified figure (right): both have brown shoulder-length hair, a short brown beard and a cross-inscribed halo, with a blue himation over a pale tunic.

Baseline pair029: Compared Jesus standing in the boat (left) with Jesus on the water in the distance (right): both have long dark-brown wavy hair, a full dark beard, the same age and face shape, and a blue-grey cloak over a pale tunic.

Baseline pair030: Compared Jesus on the water (left) with Jesus at the tomb calling out (right): both have long dark-brown wavy hair, a full dark beard, the same adult age, and a blue-grey cloak over a pale tunic.

Baseline pair031: Compared Jesus standing in the boat (left) with Jesus at the tomb (right): both have long dark-brown wavy shoulder-length hair, a full dark beard, olive skin and similar age and build.

Baseline pair032: Compared Peter stepping from the boat (left) with Peter leaping toward shore (right): both have short curly dark-grey hair, a grey salt-and-pepper beard and the same weathered middle-aged face.

Baseline pair033: Compared the crucified Jesus (left, head bowed) with Jesus standing in the boat (right): both have long dark-brown hair past the shoulders, a full dark beard and a slim olive-skinned face.
Baseline pair034: Jesus in the boat (left) is clear, but in the right image the crucified figure is a tiny distant shape on the hilltop cross, and the face is unreadable beyond dark hair.

Baseline pair035: Left Moses (beside Aaron) is bald on top with a fringe of white hair and a long chest-length white beard. Right Moses on the sea floor has a full head of swept-back white hair and a shorter beard. The bald crown is the conflicting cue.

Baseline pair036: Compared Moses at the shore (left) with Moses beside Aaron (right): both are elderly men with swept-back white hair, a full white-grey beard, a gaunt tanned face and a dark brown cloak.

Baseline pair037: Compared Moses beside Aaron (left, frontal) with Moses at the sea (right, profile): both have white-grey hair, a white beard of similar length, tanned skin and an elderly build. The right one's hair looks longer and flowing, but the frontal view on the left hides the back of his head.

Baseline pair038: Left icon Moses has long white hair flowing past his shoulders and a long white beard down to the chest. Right Moses at the sea has short grey-white hair ending at the nape and a short trimmed beard just below the chin. Hair and beard length conflict.

Baseline pair039: Compared icon Jesus in the boat (left) with Jesus at Lazarus's tomb (right): both have identical center-parted brown hair falling behind the shoulder, a short brown beard and moustache, and the same long face with a cross-halo.

Baseline pair040: Compared Jesus at the tomb (left) with the crucified Jesus (right, head bowed): both have long dark-brown wavy hair, a full dark beard and an olive-skinned slim face, with the same blue cloak over a white tunic.

Baseline pair041: Compared Peter on the water at night (left) with Peter leaping from the boat at dawn (right): both have short curly greying hair, a grey-tipped beard of the same style and length, and a similar middle-aged face. The left is greyer-looking only through night lighting, which darkens his hair and skin.

Baseline pair042: Compared icon Jesus on the water (left) with icon Jesus in the boat (right): both have the same center-parted brown hair falling behind the shoulder, a short brown beard and moustache, and the same face and halo.

Baseline pair043: Compared Moses on the sea floor (left) with Moses beside Aaron (right): both have white swept-back hair, a medium white beard, a deeply tanned weathered face and a brown cloak over a pale tunic.

Baseline pair044: Jesus on the water (right) is clear, with long dark hair and a dark beard. In the left image the crucified figure is small and distant on the cross, with his head bowed, so the face is too small to judge beyond dark hair.

Baseline pair045: Compared Moses on the sea floor (left) with Moses at the sea (right, profile): both have white-grey hair, a white beard of similar length, tanned skin, an elderly build and a brown cloak. The right one's hair looks longer, but the left view hides the back of his head.

Both show a round pit of pale dressed-stone blocks with a sandy floor and dry scrub at the rim, in soft early daylight. The right adds the wooden lid and a town with palms beyond the rim, which fits the left's view.

Peter (left foreground by the brazier; right stepping off the boat) has the same dark curly greying hair, short dark beard, middle-aged weathered face and olive skin, with a net coiled over his shoulder in both.

Both show a wooden fishing boat with a mast on dark, wind-whipped water at night, with lightning, rain and a dark shoreline. The hilly coast with lights on the left and the rocky headland on the right are compatible viewpoints of the same storm.

Both show the same kind of wooden boat with mast and lamp on a dark lake ringed by hills under heavy storm cloud. On the right the clouds are breaking and the sea is easing, but the water, shore and light are compatible.

Left Daniel (in the pit) is fair-skinned with swept-back white hair and a fuller white beard. Right Daniel (before the king) has clearly darker brown skin, close-cropped grey curls and a different, narrower face.

Both show a long corridor between towering green-blue water walls at night under dark cloud, with orange fire light in the sky. The left floor is wetter and rockier, but the layout and occasion match.

Left Daniel (at the feast) has dark brown skin and close-cropped grey curly hair. Right Daniel (in the den) is fair-skinned with longer swept-back grey hair and a different face, so the skin tone conflicts.

The left shows glassy calm water under a bright pale daylight sky, with a low flat shore and a walled town. The right shows a dark storm with rain, breaking waves and steep green hills, so the light and weather conflict.
Both show a calm lake shore at dawn with a stony and sandy beach, a small charcoal fire, a beached wooden boat, and a lakeside village with palms against distant hills, all arranged compatibly.
Both show a wooden boat with mast and sail in heavy grey-green waves under dark storm cloud with rain, and a dark green hilly headland on the left shore. The lighting and shoreline match.

Left Daniel (on the rope in the pit) has dark brown skin and close grey-white hair and beard. Right Daniel (at the feast) has lighter olive skin, dark hair greying only at the temples and a darker salt-and-pepper beard.

Left Daniel (at the feast) has olive skin, dark hair greying at the temples and a dark salt-and-pepper beard. Right Daniel (centre of the den) has noticeably darker brown skin and a whiter grey beard.

Peter (left foreground by the fire; right centre lifting the lame man) has the same dark curly greying hair, short grey-streaked beard, middle-aged face and olive skin, with a net over his shoulder and a staff in both.

Moses (left foreground with staff; right raising the rod at the rock) is an elderly man with white receding hair, a long white beard, a lean build and a brown cloak in both, though he is smaller on the right.

Left David (being anointed) is a small child of about ten with dark curly hair. Right David (dodging the spear) is a lanky adolescent or young man, so the ages clearly differ even though both have dark curls.

Both show the parted sea at night under dark moonlit cloud, with towering green water walls lining a broad sandy, rocky path. The left is seen from the shore and the right from inside the corridor, which fits.

Both show the same kind of wooden boat with torn sail and mast on a dark lake under storm cloud, with hilly shores. The right has lightning and rain while the left has breaking cloud, which is compatible for the same storm.

Moses in both halves (left, raising a hand beside Aaron; right, raising the rod at the rock) is an elderly man with swept-back white hair, a long white beard and a lean face. The brown cloak over a cream tunic also matches.
The seated Moses on the left and the white-haired leader with a staff at the centre of the column on the right both have white hair, a full white beard and the same elderly, lean build.

Both versions of David have dark, short curly hair and no beard. But the left David at the stream is a tall, muscular young man with adult proportions, while the right David being anointed is a small child who barely reaches the adults' chests, so the ages clearly differ.

The left David being anointed is a curly-haired child shown clearly. The right David stands far off in the valley behind the falling Goliath, too small to compare his face or age; only his dark short hair and beardless face can be seen, and they match.

On the left Peter is the grey-flecked, dark-bearded man lifting the beggar. The right description names no figure as Peter, and the beach shows about a dozen bearded disciples. The foreground man carrying a net looks similar, but nothing singles him out as Peter.
The slinging David on the left and the anointed David on the right are both slight, beardless boys of a similar age, with dark tousled curly hair and the same face shape.
The standing Moses on the left and the seated Moses on the right both have thin white hair, a long white beard and an elderly, lean face, and both wear a brown mantle over a cream tunic.

Both halves show the sea at night under dark, stormy clouds, with teal-green water, a wet sandy floor and rocky cliffs along the edges. The left shows the shore where the path opens; the right looks down the path between walls of water. The two are compatible.

The skin tones conflict. On the left, Daniel being lifted from the den has light olive skin and greying dark hair. On the right, Daniel standing among the lions has clearly dark brown skin and short black hair.
The anointed David on the left and the David standing by the stream on the right are both slim, beardless youths. They share dark curly hair and distinctly ruddy cheeks, and their ages are close.

Peter by the brazier on the left and Peter lifting the lame man on the right both have dark curly hair streaked with grey, a short greying beard and a middle-aged face. Both also carry a fishing net over a brown cloak.

The skin tone and hair conflict. On the left, Daniel in the den has dark brown skin and short black hair. On the right, Daniel before Belshazzar has light olive skin and swept-back grey-streaked hair.
The David slinging the stone on the left and the David standing with his staff on the right are both slim, beardless youths with dark curly hair and the same face shape and age.
Daniel before Belshazzar on the left and Daniel lifted from the den on the right have the same light olive skin, greying dark hair, short grey-dark beard and middle-aged, lean face.

The right description does not name David, but the youth dodging Saul's spear is the only other figure in the room. Like the left David at the stream, he is a slim, beardless youth with dark curly hair and a bag on a strap.
Moses at the rock on the left and Moses at the parted sea on the right are both elderly men with swept-back white hair, a long white beard and a lean face. Both wear a brown cloak over a cream tunic.

Peter helping the lame man on the left and Peter stepping out of the boat on the right both have dark curly hair going grey, a short dark-grey beard and a middle-aged face. Both carry a net over the shoulder.

The left description shows only 'the disciples' and never singles out Peter among about 16 figures. The central net-carrying man (dark curly greying hair, short beard) resembles the leaping Peter on the right, but that identification is a guess.
Compared Moses striking the rock (left) with Moses seated on the stone (right): both are elderly, with long white hair, a long white beard and the same face.
Compared leaping Peter (left) with Peter gripping the lame man's hand (right): both have dark curly greying hair, a short grey-flecked beard, a middle-aged face and a similar build.
Compared young David dodging the spear (left) with David choosing stones (right): both are clean-shaven youths with short dark curly hair, the same lean face and the same skin tone.

Left has a dark navy night sky with the fire pillar between smooth green walls. Right is pale daylight or dawn, with teal curling walls and a hillside city at the end of the path, so night conflicts with day.

Both show the path at night under dark stormy clouds, between towering dark teal foaming walls of water, with a wet rocky or muddy floor. This is compatible with the same crossing seen from different points.
Compared Moses at the sea (left) with Moses striking the rock (right): both are elderly, with long white hair, a long white beard and the same lean face.

The left description names only 'the disciples' and does not single out Peter. The foreground man with staff and net (dark curly greying hair, grey beard) looks like the right-side Peter, but I can't confirm he is Peter.

Compared seated Moses (left) with standing Moses holding his staff (right): both are elderly, with white hair, a full white beard, a similar face and similar skin tone. The right-hand hair is slightly shorter, but nothing conflicts.

The left description names only 'the disciples', so Peter is not singled out among the four men at the fire. The foreground net-carrier resembles the right-side Peter stepping onto the water, but I can't confirm he is Peter.
Compared Daniel standing in the den (left) with Daniel holding the rope (right): both have brown skin, short dark greying hair, a short grey beard and the same middle-aged face.

Both are at night under stormy dark clouds, with the same dark teal foaming walls of water and wet rocky ground. The right image is viewed from the shore, so only one wall is visible, but nothing conflicts.

Left is bright daylight, with a wooden door, stone steps and a trapdoor above the rim. Right has a dark blue night sky and a round barred wooden hatch on the rim, so day conflicts with night and the rim structures differ.

Left Daniel (on the rope) has medium-dark brown skin, short dark hair and a close-cropped grey beard. Right Daniel (in the vision) has visibly paler skin, wispy grey hair, a longer grey beard and a gaunter, older face.
Compared Moses at the shore (left) with Moses seated on the hill (right): both are elderly, with white hair, a long white beard and the same face.

Compared Peter stepping onto the water (left) with Peter lifting the lame man (right): both have dark curly hair, a short dark beard and a middle-aged face. The right one is slightly greyer, but there is no clear conflict.
Both show the same dusty cobbled road in warm light, with a white columned building, cypresses, flat-roofed stone houses and terraced hills. The viewpoints differ but the layout is compatible.

In the left courtyard, Peter (foreground, with net and staff) has greying curly hair and a clearly grey-white short beard. In the right image, the Peter stepping onto the water has dark curly hair, a dark beard the same tone as his hair and darker skin. The beard colour conflicts even allowing for moonlight.

On the left beach, the Peter with staff and net and in the right courtyard foreground, Peter both have dark wavy-to-curly hair, a greying short beard, a middle-aged weathered face and a sturdy build. The hair is a little curlier on the left, but no identity cue conflicts.
The leaping Peter (left) and the courtyard Peter (right foreground) share dark curly hair, a salt-and-pepper short beard, a middle-aged face, olive skin and a stocky build.
Seated Moses (left centre) and the Moses with staff at the right edge are both elderly, with long white hair, a full white beard and a lean face.

Both show a dusty dirt road through olive groves and scrub, with a white-walled village and a white columned building in the distance and a lake to the right, in the same clear daylight. The right adds the stone house and low wall at the road's edge, which is compatible with the left's view.

The courtyard Peter (left foreground) and the Peter leaping from the boat (right centre) both have short curly dark hair going grey, a greying short beard, a middle-aged broad face and a similar build.

The courtyard Peter (left) and the Peter with net and staff at the right edge of the shore scene are both middle-aged, with short dark-to-greying hair, a salt-and-pepper short beard and a similar build. The right face is slightly leaner, but no clear cue conflicts.
The standing shepherd (left centre) and the slinger (right) are both a slim, beardless youth with short dark curly hair and ruddy cheeks, wearing the same brown tunic and bag.
Both the kneeling youth being anointed (left centre) and the youth fleeing the spear (right) are beardless and slight, with short dark curly hair and a youthful face.
Both show a dusty road between low stone walls and olive trees, with stone houses, a lake in the distance and a cloudy golden late-day sky. The terrain and lighting are compatible.
The small David in the left background and the David choosing stones (right) are both a beardless, slim youth with short dark curly hair in a brown tunic.

Both show the same small wooden single-masted boat with a pale sail and rigging, crowded with disciples, on open choppy water. The left has storm, rain and lightning, while the right shows the sky clearing and the sail slackening as the storm is stilled, which fits the same occasion.
The youth fleeing the spear (left) and the standing shepherd (right) are both beardless and slim, with short dark curly hair and a youthful face.
The youth dodging the spear (left) and the slinger (right) are both beardless and slim, with short dark curly hair and a youthful face.
The Moses with staff (left foreground) and the seated Moses (right centre) are both elderly, with white swept-back hair, a full white beard and a lean face.
The Moses striking the rock (left centre) and the Moses with staff (right foreground) are both elderly, with white hair, a long white beard and a lean, weathered face.
The Moses striking the rock (left) and the Moses with staff in a brown cloak beside Aaron (right) are both elderly, with white hair, a full white beard and a lean face.

Left Peter (leaping figure) has dark curly hair and a grey-streaked short beard; the right description names only 'the disciples' and no figure is singled out as Peter, although the foreground man with the staff looks similar.

Both show choppy open lake water, low hills on the horizon and a single-mast wooden fishing boat; the left sky is lighter and the sail torn, which fits the storm being stilled, while the right shows the storm at its height with lightning.
Both show a single-mast wooden fishing boat in dark, lightning-lit storm waves with spray and rain under the same grey-blue sky; the right is a closer view of the hull.
Both show a pebbly lakeshore at misty dawn, with olive and cypress-dotted hills and a small stone village on the right bank and a beached wooden boat; the arrangement is compatible.

Left Peter by the brazier has dark curly grey-streaked hair and a grizzled beard; the right description names only 'the disciples', so no figure is singled out as Peter (the foreground man with the net and staff is similar).
Left Peter stepping from the boat has grey hair and a grey beard; the right description names only 'the disciples', so no figure in the shore crowd is singled out as Peter.

Both Peters have curly salt-and-pepper hair, a grey beard and a lean, weathered middle-aged face (left at night on the water, right lifting the lame man); the left looks slightly greyer, which the moonlit palette explains.
Both Peters (left by the brazier, right mid-leap) have dark curly grey-streaked hair, a short grizzled beard and a lean, lined middle-aged face.
Both Peters (left lifting the beggar at the temple, right mid-leap from the boat) have dark curly greying hair, a short grey-streaked beard and the same lean, weathered face.

Hair colour conflicts: left Peter on the water has distinctly grey hair and a grey beard (the disciples around him have dark hair), while right Peter in the courtyard has dark brown-black hair and a mostly dark beard and looks younger.
Moses in both (left seated with arms supported, right raising the rod at the rock) is a lean elderly man with white hair and a long white beard.
Daniel in both (left standing among the lions, right being drawn up) is an older man with short grey-white hair and a short grey beard and has the same face shape.

Left Peter on the water has black curly hair, a fully black beard and a younger face; on the right, the coat-wrapped foreground man (and the other coat-clutching candidate) has clearly greying hair and beard and looks older.
Left Peter lifting the lame man and the right foreground man with the coat drawn around his shoulders share dark curly greying hair, a grey-streaked beard and a lean, lined middle-aged face.
Moses in both (left standing in the camp, right seated on the hill) is an elderly man with white hair, a long white beard and a lean, lined face.
Moses at the rock (left, small but visible) and at the sea (right) are both elderly, with white hair and a long white beard; no identity cue conflicts.
Both show a pebbly lakeshore at misty sunrise (sun at the right), flat-roofed stone houses with palms on the left bank, low hills beyond and a small fire on the beach.

Both are circular pale-stone pits in sandy ground with palms, but the left is a shallow, wide pit with a plain unbroken wall and a round wooden lid, while the right is a deep narrow shaft with barred iron gates, wall torches, stone stairs and a rectangular hatch. The architecture of the pit conflicts.
Moses seated at centre-left and Moses striking the rock at centre-right are both elderly, with long white hair, a full white beard and a brown cloak over a pale robe.
Moses with the staff in the left foreground and Moses at the rock on the right share long white hair, a full white beard, an elderly face and a brown cloak.
Peter in the coat in the left foreground and the leaping Peter on the right share curly dark hair going grey, a short salt-and-pepper beard, a middle-aged face and a lean build.
Peter lifting the lame man at left centre and Peter by the brazier in the right foreground share dark curly greying hair, a short grizzled beard and a lean, lined middle-aged face.
Moses seated at the centre of the left image and Moses with arm outstretched at the right share long white hair, a full white beard and an elderly face.
Peter gripping the lame man's hand at left centre and the leaping Peter on the right share curly dark greying hair, a short dark-grey beard and a middle-aged face.

The standing shepherd on the left and the kneeling youth being anointed on the right share short dark curly hair, a beardless youthful look and a slight build. The right face is bowed, but the hair and age match.

Daniel at the feast on the left has dark hair greying only at the temples and a dark short beard. On the right he has grey-white hair and a grey beard and looks clearly older, despite the same blue mantle.
The slinger on the left and the youth dodging Saul's spear on the right share short dark curly hair, a beardless young face and a slight build.

The left shows the boat at night in a violent storm, with dark clouds and breaking waves. The right shows flat, calm water under a pale daylight sky with a distant shoreline town, so night conflicts with day and storm with calm.
The youth fleeing the spear on the left and the boy being anointed at centre-right share short dark curly hair, a beardless youthful face and a slim build.
The staff-bearing leader in the front row of the left image and Moses at the rock on the right are both elderly, with white hair and a long white beard.
Moses at the shore on the left and Moses seated on the right share long white hair, a full white beard, an elderly face and a brown cloak.
David standing at the centre of the left image and the youth against the wall on the right share short dark hair, a beardless young face and a slight build. The left figure is small but legible.

The kneeling youth being anointed on the left and the slinger on the right share short dark curly hair, a beardless youthful look and a slight build. The left face is bowed, but the hair and age match.
